title: I Studied 100+ Profitable Apps, Here’s What Actually Works
description:
Start building & deploying paywalls in 10 minutes flat: https://superwall.com/

Apply for 1:1 help from Joseph to grow your app: https://joinconsumerclub.com/apply

Hire fractional head of organic growth in-house: https://agency.joinconsumerclub.com/

Spy on outlier TikToks that went viral promoting apps: https://spytok.com/

Hosted & produced by Joseph Choi: https://twitter.com/JosephKChoi
Some of the apps making real money right now look ridiculous from the outside. A Pomodoro timer with a cat on it made $40K in 2 months. A 15-second TikTok about an app that didn’t even exist yet pulled 4,000 waitlist signups.
Meanwhile, most founders are still spending months polishing onboarding before a single person has seen their idea.
I’ve talked to over 1,000 app founders and built organic growth systems behind 180M+ views and $6.5M in ARR. These are the apps that changed how I think about building, launching, and pricing, including a few that looked like wins until I saw what was actually happening behind the scenes.
You’ll learn:
 1️⃣ How one 15-second TikTok got 4,000 waitlist signups for an app that wasn’t built yet
 2️⃣ Pain apps vs. passion apps, and why a cat-themed timer made $40K in 2 months
 3️⃣ How GoTall carved out ~$150K/month inside a niche Umax already dominated
 4️⃣ The “killer feature” test, and why complicated apps can still sell in 3 seconds
 5️⃣ Why 3M views brought in the wrong customers, and the repositioning that fixed it
 6️⃣ The weekly vs. annual pricing mistake that quietly caps your LTV
Topics this video covers: app ideas, app ideas that make money, how to validate an app idea, how to build an app waitlist, app marketing strategy, tiktok app marketing, ugc app strategy, app pricing strategy, paywall pricing, how to grow an app, app growth guide
